summary: Frontend validation of the new Workflows page (3 boards + owner-only delete). 33 of 35 checks passed. All 7 review scenarios PASS functionally: tabs, columns, cards rendering, owner delete button visibility+action, non-owner (sales) cannot see delete, Advance still works, and the ZZTEST card was created + deleted successfully. The only 2 'failures' are demo-data drift, not code bugs: the sample cards 'Order #4821 — Delhi Retailer' and 'Order #4822 — Mumbai Boutique' currently sit in 'ready' and 'delivered' respectively (not 'in_production' / 'dispatched' as the review expected). The cards exist and the boards work — they've simply been advanced through the pipeline by prior activity.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> inside <select data-testid='wf-contact-select'>. Emergent's dev-mode injected <span> wrapper is being rendered inside the <option> in Workflows.js line 67 (`{c.company || c.name}`). Non-blocking in prod (only fires in dev/preview), but produces a console error every time the dialog opens.
A11y warning (recurring): 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — NewWorkflowDialog has no <DialogDescription>.

action_items: (Optional / cosmetic) Demo data drift — 'Order #4821' is now in 'ready' and 'Order #4822' is in 'delivered'. If the review script assumes fresh demo positions, add an idempotent stage-reset in the seed_demo/fixup_demo_tenant so demo cards land in the intended review columns.
(Optional a11y polish) Add DialogDescription to NewWorkflowDialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Workflows.js: TABS correctly lists production / distribution / purchase_payment; STAGES map matches backend WORKFLOW_STAGES; default `useState('production')` — verified in UI (Production tab has bg-brand-ink class on load).
Delete button is correctly gated by `user?.role === 'owner'` — confirmed via cross-check: 2 delete buttons on owner's production tab, 0 delete buttons for sales user across all three tabs.

del() handler correctly uses window.confirm then DELETE /api/workflows/{id}, invalidates both `['workflows', tab]` and `['dashboard']` queries, and surfaces backend error via `e.response?.data?.detail`. Verified end-to-end: created 'ZZTEST Delete Me' -> deleted -> confirmed via API GET (count returned to 2, no ZZTEST title present).
advance() correctly guards against final-stage advance (`toast.info('Already at final stage')`) — the ready/delivered cards therefore correctly show a Chip instead of an Advance button.
NewWorkflowDialog.contactType branch (`type === 'purchase_payment' ? 'vendor' : 'customer'`) is wired but not verified end-to-end for vendor selection (out of scope for this review).

Console noise: <span> inside <option> hydration error in the wf-contact-select — Emergent's dev instrumentation is injecting a wrapper span into the option. If this can be surpressed by using a plain string child (which the code already does — {c.company || c.name}), then the instrumentation itself is the culprit. Worth flagging to main agent but is not a functional bug.
